answer.explanation: Every Thumbnailer invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET (944 such errors from before 00:00 UTC onward, with Errors metric bursts at 00:20-00:34 and from 00:46 UTC). The bucket the function is configured to write to does not exist. This is not an IAM problem, since the error is NoSuchBucket rather than AccessDenied. Memory (max used about 114 MB of 1024 MB) and duration (about 100 ms) look normal. The other three functions show no errors. I could not read the environment variable, the IaC template or the commit history with the tools available, so the IAC and CODE layers are not ruled out; the OUTPUT_BUCKET value is the most direct candidate.
